title: DSSSB Photo and Signature Resizer: Prepare Uploads to the Current Notice
description: Prepare DSSSB photo, signature and thumb-impression uploads. Check the current notice, match each file's dimensions and KB limit, then verify before submitting.
intro: DSSSB application portals can require a photograph, signature and thumb impressions as separate uploads. The exact requirements can vary by recruitment notice, so use the latest official instructions as your authority. The values below are a preparation reference from the supplied third-party DSSSB guidance, not an official confirmation or a promise that every recruitment uses the same specification.

sections.heading: Reference values: treat the notice as final
paragraphs: The supplied ResizeForForms DSSSB page (reported as last verified July 2026) lists a coloured postcard-style photograph at 480 × 672 pixels, JPEG/JPG, 50–300 KB, described as 5 × 7 inches, and signature and thumb-impression files at 110 × 140 pixels, JPEG/JPG, up to 40 KB. It also describes a white background and dark/black ink for the signature and says both left and right thumb impressions are required on the DSSSB OARS portal. These are third-party-reported values, not independently confirmed here against a current official recruitment notice.

The 480 × 672 dimensions correspond to 5 × 7 inches at 96 pixels per inch, not 300 DPI. At 300 DPI, 5 × 7 inches would be 1500 × 2100 pixels. The article's supplied earlier figures also mention 3.5 × 4.5 cm / 413 × 531 pixels at 300 DPI. Since these represent different physical sizes and resolutions, do not treat them as interchangeable. Verify the exact dimensions and any DPI requirement in your own current DSSSB advertisement and portal.

sections.heading: Prepare the photograph
paragraphs: Start with a clear, correctly oriented source image. Check the official instructions about background, framing, face position, both ears/shoulders if specified, and whether the image must be recent. Avoid filters or edits that alter identity or violate application rules.

For the third-party-listed 480 × 672 photo reference, choose the Photo role and Photo 480 × 672 preset in the DSSSB Photo Resizer. The tool targets at most 300 KB; check the current notice for any minimum file size and other conditions. Its preset is a convenience based on supplied guidance, not an official DSSSB endorsement or a guarantee that the preset is correct for every post.

sections.heading: Prepare the signature and thumb impressions separately
paragraphs: A signature or thumb impression is not a photograph. The supplied reference lists 110 × 140 pixels and up to 40 KB in JPEG/JPG for both, but you must confirm these details in your current official notice and OARS portal. For a signature, the reference recommends black/dark ink on white paper; for thumb impressions, it says left and right are required. Follow any current instructions about scanning, image count, naming or file format.

In the tool, select Signature or Thumb impression for the relevant image, then enter its verified dimensions and maximum KB before processing. Each upload is processed one at a time. The current tool does not yet batch three files or offer a combined Download All action; run each file separately and keep the outputs clearly named. Photo presets do not apply to signatures or thumb impressions.

sections.heading: A reliable step-by-step workflow
paragraphs: 1. Open the current official DSSSB advertisement and application instructions. 2. Make a separate checklist for the photo, signature, left thumb and right thumb as required. 3. Keep untouched source copies. 4. Crop each image according to the specified framing. 5. Enter the exact dimensions and maximum KB from the current notice. 6. Choose an accepted format. 7. Reopen every export and verify dimensions, type, size and legibility. 8. Upload each to the matching portal field and review the portal's preview or validation message.

The resizer tries to approach a target size; exact KB output cannot be guaranteed for every source image. If the target is too small to preserve readable detail, do not submit a distorted or illegible result—re-check the instructions and source capture.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting common upload errors
paragraphs: If the portal rejects a file, read the exact error and compare it with the current instructions. Check for a wrong extension, dimensions off by a pixel, a file at rather than below a maximum, incorrect aspect ratio, unintended transparency or a signature uploaded in the photo field.

Some portals re-encode files after upload or interpret size units differently. Leave reasonable headroom below a maximum where possible, but do not guess a new dimension or format if the official notice specifies one. Re-export from the original rather than repeatedly compressing an already compressed copy.

sections.heading: Privacy and careful handling
paragraphs: The DSSSB Photo Resizer processes the selected image in your browser according to the tool's current implementation. The general resizer and compressor tools are also browser-based. Check each tool page for its stated behavior, and avoid using a shared device for sensitive application materials unless you can clear local downloads and browser data afterward.

Keep the official notice and your source files until the application is submitted and accepted. A correctly sized image does not guarantee that an application meets every recruitment requirement; it only helps prepare the image upload.

faq.question: What photo size is listed in the supplied DSSSB reference?
faq.answer: The referenced third-party page lists 480 × 672 pixels, JPEG/JPG and 50–300 KB for a coloured postcard-style photo. Verify the current official notice before relying on these values; requirements can vary.

faq.question: What signature and thumb size does the supplied reference list?
faq.answer: It lists 110 × 140 pixels, JPEG/JPG and up to 40 KB for signature and thumb impression uploads, and says left and right thumbs are required. Confirm these details in your current DSSSB notice and portal.

faq.question: Why does the guide mention different postcard pixel dimensions at 300 DPI?
faq.answer: Physical size and DPI determine pixel dimensions: 5 × 7 inches at 96 DPI is 480 × 672 pixels, while at 300 DPI it is 1500 × 2100 pixels. The official notice's pixel dimensions and DPI take precedence; don't mix these references.

faq.question: Can this tool guarantee the exact DSSSB upload size?
faq.answer: The tool works toward the target KB you enter, but exact file size is not guaranteed for every image. Verify the saved file and follow the portal's current validation.

faq.question: Can I process photo, signature and thumb impressions together?
faq.answer: Not currently. The tool processes one image per run. Select its role, enter the relevant notice-specific settings, process and download it, then repeat for each required upload.

faq.question: What should I do if the upload is rejected?
faq.answer: Use the portal's error message and current official instructions to check format, dimensions, size, aspect ratio and whether the file was uploaded to the correct field. Do not rely on a guessed or outdated preset.

faq.question: Is the DSSSB Photo Resizer officially provided by DSSSB?
faq.answer: No. iLoveMyFiles is an independent utility site. The tool helps resize an image to values you provide; it is not an official DSSSB service or endorsement.
